stem:
The table shows the numbers of tomato plants and spinach plants in five different gardens.

Garden Plants

| Garden | Number of Tomato Plants | Number of Spinach Plants |
|--------|-------------------------|--------------------------|
| K      | 34                      | 43                       |
| L      | 26                      | 35                       |
| M      | 38                      | 47                       |
| N      | 29                      | 38                       |
| P      | 45                      | 54                       |

Based on the relationship shown in the table, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: There are 9 more spinach plants than tomato plants in each garden.

options.label: B
options.text: There are 9 fewer spinach plants than tomato plants in each garden.

options.label: C
options.text: There are 8 more spinach plants than tomato plants in each garden.

options.label: D
options.text: There are 8 fewer spinach plants than tomato plants in each garden.

visual_elements: Table with columns Garden, Number of Tomato Plants, Number of Spinach Plants; rows K(34,43), L(26,35), M(38,47), N(29,38), P(45,54)
difficulty_rationale: Students need to calculate the difference between the number of spinach and tomato plants for each garden and recognize the pattern, which is a straightforward comparison task.
